dict.string: Waypoint uses your camera during lock-in so Presage can estimate heart rate, breathing, and stress while you study. Frames stay on your Mac except when sent to Presage and Gemini for that session.
Waypoint records a short microphone clip so you can dictate to Copilot and run Voice tests in Mission Control.
Waypoint turns your spoken words into text for Copilot and Voice tests using on-device speech recognition when available.
Waypoint reads the frontmost app, window title, and browser tabs via System Events so lock-in coaching can tell on-task work from distractions.
